title: Cancel an Owner-Builder Permit
summary: This page explains that an Owner-Builder Permit can only be cancelled if a clear error was made when the permit was originally granted.
intro:
After an Owner-Builder Permit has been granted, there is no option for cancellation unless a clear error was made at the time of granting, and the permit should not have been issued.

Changing your mind, or altering plans, or contracting a licensed builder to carry out the work, are not considered errors, and the permit cannot be cancelled.
who_can_apply: Must satisfy the Director-General that 'special circumstances exist' (section 31(3) of the Home Building Act 1989)
what_you_need: Satisfy the Director-General that 'special circumstances exist' (section 31(3) of the Home Building Act 1989)

faqs.q: Can I cancel my Owner-Builder Permit if I change my mind or alter my plans?
faqs.a: No, changing your mind, altering plans, or contracting a licensed builder are not considered errors, and the permit cannot be cancelled.

faqs.q: Under what circumstances can an Owner-Builder Permit be cancelled?
faqs.a: Cancellation is only possible if a clear error was made at the time the permit was granted, and the permit should not have been issued.
